collection.title: Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades (without Spray Bar)
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz S Class Saloon 2014 - 2020 will fit, this model requires a 25" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 22" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
